finding.claim: The /rss endpoint fetches a URL taken directly from the query string with no validation. An attacker can make the server request internal hosts, cloud metadata endpoints (e.g. http://169.254.169.254/), localhost services, or arbitrary external hosts. The first 400 bytes of the response are returned, so this is a partially non-blind SSRF.

trace.note: params[:u] is passed unvalidated to URI.open, which performs the HTTP(S)/FTP request, and .read fetches the body
First 400 bytes of the response body are returned to the attacker

finding.guards_checked: No host allowlist, scheme check, or private/link-local IP block. The TRUSTED allowlist on line 5 is only used by /trusted, not /rss. No authentication on the route.

verdict.reason: app.rb:8 passes the query parameter params[:u] straight to URI.open(...).read with no validation, auth, or middleware, and app.rb:9 returns the first 400 bytes. The TRUSTED check at app.rb:14 only guards /trusted.
